notes: WR1 / WR2 / WR3+ = the receiver's rank by targets among his team's wide receivers that season
tilt = (his share − league share) × dropbacks / (dropbacks + 300); a 40-throw sample barely moves the needle
first-start study: a passer's first game (15+ dropbacks) for a team he had no earlier game with in 2024–26, against the rest of his own games
